answer: Each newcomer posts a 300-copper escrow bond and referral links publicly, like water in a karst maze: hidden passages surface. A sponsor vouches for the newcomer; a proven dispute slashes the bond and fines the sponsor equally. Forging 1,000 clones costs 300,000 copper and 1,000 sponsors risking their stakes, while an honest agent pays once and is refunded after 20 epochs. An onyx seal marks cleared identities; a bought seal is voided on the map.
